Locators are printed page numbers; PDF page = printed page for both files (full report 71 pages with a "PAGE n" footer; Technical Appendix 25 pages). Appendix Exhibits TA3.1-TA3.3 (techno-economic assumptions, USD, price year not stated; pre-2020 sources inflated with an OECD PPI) carry the unit costs: 7 digestion steam technologies (gas, oil, coal, electric and hydrogen boilers, MVR, CST tower with 14 h storage), 3 calciners (fossil CFB, hydrogen, electric) and 3 smelters (Hall-Heroult, HH+CCS, inert anodes). Loaded: TRL, availability year, lifetime, 2020 efficiency, final energy derived as thermal intensity (6.75 GJ/t digestion, 3 GJ/t calcination) divided by efficiency, capex per t alumina and per kW, fixed, variable and total OPEX excluding fuel, smelter capex (greenfield, brownfield, retrofit as target), total OPEX, electricity, alumina input, and direct emissions read from the labelled bars of Exhibit TA3.3. Full report: Exhibits 1.10-1.12 (2030 direct emissions, 2035 levelised cost, regional marker labels loaded as min and max), Box 5 (2035 brownfield LCOX and break-even carbon cost), whole-refinery 9.8 GJ/t and secondary aluminium 0.5 t CO2e/t. In _other-values: 2050 efficiencies, OPEX components, power options (TA4.1), context numbers, secondary energy 3.3 GJ/t.
